claimContract: observable = f(geometry_state, architecture_state, scale_state, precision_state, measurement_operator)
claim: The declared local model and prompt inventory reproduce or clearly disagree with the published layerwise expansion-compression profile when global TwoNN, Levina-Bickel MLE, and local nearest-neighbor ID are reported separately.
primaryObservable: Per-layer global TwoNN estimate with bootstrap interval, Levina-Bickel Eq. 8 MLE at the minimum connected geodesic neighborhood, and the full local-ID map with mean, mode, spread, and neighborhood identity.
explicitFalsifier: The estimators do not show a commensurable expansion-compression profile, disagree beyond their reported finite-sample behavior, or fail sample-convergence and synthetic coverage controls.
baselineCommand: MC_BACKEND=mlx poetry run mc --json analyze dimension-profile --model ${MODEL_PATH} --probes ${PROBE_PATH} --samples ${PROBE_COUNT} --local --with-mle --with-ci > results/ws4_2_intrinsic_dimension/${RUN_ID}/dimension_profile.json

comparisonBudget.layers: all transformer blocks exposed by the model
